name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 3 November 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/1818 as regards the definition of prohibited weapons
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking a Commission rule that would narrow which weapons count as banned for EU sustainable investment labels. The new rule would only cover four types: anti-personnel mines, cluster munitions, biological and chemical weapons. The Parliament says this lets companies making nuclear weapons or depleted uranium qualify for "green" investment funds. It asks the Commission to write a new rule that clearly excludes these weapons too.

- **What changes:** The Commission's narrower weapons definition is rejected; the old broader one stays for now.
- **Who it affects:** Fund managers running EU climate benchmarks, and defence companies seeking green labels.
- **What happens next:** The rule cannot enter into force; the Commission must propose a stricter replacement.
